stacy dolan.name: Stacy Dolan
stacy dolan.origin: The daughter of New York City police captain Arthur Dolan. Stacy grew up the childhood friends of Danny and Barbara Ketch and Jack D'Auria. As they grew older Stacy and Dan developed a romantic relationship. Stacy had aspirations to become a police officer like her father. Her life changed when she found out that Dan was in the hospital and his sister was in a coma. All she knew was they witnessed a murder and the sole suspect was the Ghost Rider. After that night Stacy noticed a pattern as familiar neighborhood faces had been murdered. Ghost Rider was involved in some way but she had not realized to what extent. ===Fear=== One night after graduating from the police academy Stacy went to visit Barbara at her grave. To her surprise she found Ghost Rider paying his respects to her friend. Confused she confronted Ghost Rider and realized he did not want to hurt her or anyone. These instincts proved valid when Scarecrow kidnapped Stacy believing her to be his mother. She was rescued by Ghost Rider and Captain America. ===Siege of Darkness=== Stacy teamed up with Ghost Rider and the Midnight Sons during the event known as the Siege of Darkness where she acted as an unofficial representative of the NYPD and worked in conjunction with the Midnight Sons to help stop the growing threats of Lilith and Zarathos. It was during this battle that she discovered Dan was indeed the Ghost Rider. ===Betrayal=== Stacy was concerned that Daniel was being entirely consumed by the Ghost Rider persona. She volunteered for the police task force assigned to capture the Ghost Rider and received extensive S.H.I.E.L.D. training as a result. She saw it as an effort to rescue Daniel from himself. When the task force had succeeded in capturing Ghost Rider it was only then that Stacy realized her true mistake. Ghost Rider did manage to escape, but the events led to a tumultuous relationship. Stacy's knowledge of the secret identity of her lover were wiped clean by Jennifer Kale, supposedly to protect Stacy from Ghost Rider's enemies. As Stacy maintained no memory of what she did in the past, she was free to restart her relationship anew. ===Vanguard=== Dolan and her partner, Detective Brett Mahoney, were tasked with solving the murder of a John Doe, despite the fact that he was left unidentifiable by any earthly means, and that his death was witnessed by the Watcher. They located a witness who placed Jaafar Yoosuf at the scene. Dolan had arrested Yoosuf months earlier for trying to buy superpowers. Her investigation led to Yoosuf's apartment where she was shot by one of her own police officers. The investigation was turned upside down when ballistics showed the bullets in John Doe came from her gun. After her arrest, she survived a failed assassination attempt by Dominic Fortune. Dolan discovered that Fortune was a member of a black ops team Vanguard, and convinced them of her innocence by exposing Yoosuf as a villain with the ability to possess the minds of others. When she captured Yoosuf, he was killed by Blade. The John Doe arrived at their facility to reveal that he was a former Vanguard member, Trenton Craft known as Colonel America, and that his telekinetic powers allowed him to survive his murder and autopsy. Unfortunately, he had to destroy Dolan and the entire team roster to preserve the secret identity of Vanguard. The Vanguard members survived thanks to the intervention of Retcon, whose powers allowed her to make Craft think he had killed them, forcing the rest of them to go into hiding. Later, Dolan snuck into the apartment of her former partner, Mahoney, to give him a written account of the investigation. She warned him that after reading it, he would realize he can't tell anybody, but she didn't want to possibly die without sharing the truth with someone.

stalax.name: Stalax
stalax.first_appearance: Saga of Crystar, Crystal Warrior Vol 1 1
stalax.origin: Stalax was a captain of Crystalium's royal guard. He willingly turned himself into a Crystal Warrior to help his King in his fight against the forces of Chaos. Stalax was killed by a Master of the World brainwashed Nova, who turned him into a blade of pure crystal after shattering him with a blast. After being freed from the Master of the World's control, Nova apologized to Warbow for killing both Stalax and Crystar, Warbow told him not to worry, all they needed to do was fuse their crystals and they would be back to normal, confirming that Stalax was alive after all.

stalker mutant.name: Stalker (Mutant)
stalker mutant.origin: Wasp's agent, Harlan, in an attempt to create more publicity for her, hired this disturbed young mutant to attack her, paying him in Wasp mementos. He attacked her with electricity over a phone call through the telephone wires, but she managed to get away and call the police who traced the call. Going to the Stalker's house to investigate the attack, she met the Stalker himself, who presented her with a bouquet of flowers made from electricity. She rebuked him and he became angry and attacked her with electricity from the lamp in his room. The Stalker nearly overloaded, absorbing electricity from Wasp's costume, but she helped him by redirecting it into the ground. Leaning Harlan had set them both up, Janet fired him.

stalker psychic.name: Stalker (Psychic)
stalker psychic.origin: The Stalker was an unnamed mutant who became obsessed with and stalked Mary Jane Watson during her time as the wife of Spider-Man. The stalker, once an ordinary man, manifested his mutant powers and absorbed all of Peter's memories when he was saved by him during one of Spider-Man's fights on the streets of New York. Consumed with obsession over Mary Jane because of his false memories, the Stalker harassed her with phone calls and eventually kidnapped her during a plane explosion to fake her death and hold her captive. Spider-Man eventually managed to save Mary Jane and defeat the Stalker. Mary Jane, however, was traumatized by the experience and needed time away from her life as the wife of a superhero, which led to their separation and divorce.

stallior.origin: Stallior was one of the Inhumans who fought on Maximus' side during his coup against Black Bolt and helped Maximus escape in a spaceship with other supporters. During their trial, Stallior turned against his fellow conspirators. Still, he was exiled along with them. ... Apparently, he was allowed to return, as he was later tasked with guarding the imprisoned Maximus. He was then brainwashed by Leonus who had been struck by a Kree mind-control device to free Maximus from his prison, allowing him to round up half of the Inhumans to return them to the Kree. Leonus, Stallior and Falcona were brainwashed by Maximus into being members of the who were also under his thrall.

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.origin: A mercenary-minded silver-medal runner with a serious need to win, Stampede worked as Flare's partner for years before they joined Shadowforce Alpha. After Cordite and Clash took out most of Col. Broga's bodyguards, Flare and Stampede burst into the room to finish them off. Stampede kicked the sole survivor, Cary Armstrong, towards the window, and retreated with Flare when the Scarlet Spider arrived .; Flare and Stampede watched Cordite and Clash in the operating theater, where Stampede watched with displeasure as Clash jeopardized the mission with her concern for Cordite. They were soon joined by Shell and Broga, with the Scarlet Spider hot on their heels. Stampede took him on, only to be punched through a window and into the arms of the SWAT team below .

stan landers.name: Stan Landers
stan landers.origin: Stan Landers was an operative at Soul Star Research during multiple attempts to contain and study the energy entity Zzzax. During an early recreation of Zzzax by the project’s scientists, Landers was partially absorbed into the entity. His lingering emotional attachment to colleague Alexandria Knox subtly influenced Zzzax’s behavior. When Zzzax abducted Knox, the entity battled the Hulk until Mark Revel managed to disperse it using a copper conductor and a lightning storm. During the crisis, Landers succeeded in forcibly extracting himself from Zzzax in order to save Knox. However, the vast amount of electrical energy he had absorbed proved fatal, and Landers was disintegrated shortly afterward.

stan witts.name: Stan Witts
stan witts.origin: Stan Witts was one of the NYPD detectives who investigated the murder of Frank Castle's family in Central Park, his partner was the older John Laviano. He, along with Laviano, helped Frank identify the killers (mobsters of the Costa family) after his recovery. However, their supervisor, Howard Furniss, prohibited them to go along with the investigation on orders from the top hierarchy of the department (implying its corruption). Stan and John later received reports of several assaults on the Costas' network, which they accepted to deal with while, in reality, they threw away the dossier in retaliation for the police cover-up. Stan later informed Laviano of the twenty-six dead men found at Salvagno's, at the hands of the man responsible for the attacks all along, Frank Castle, by then turned into the Punisher.

stanley carter.name: Stanley Carter
stanley carter.species: Human enhanced by experimental drugs, and later by Kindred
stanley carter.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 107
stanley carter.origin: ===Early Life=== Stanley Carter's parents were drug addicts who became romantically involved with one another. Stanley's father later died, leaving Stanley's mother pregnant and alone. Stanley's mother was sent to a rehabilitation clinic and Stanley went to be raised by his grandparents in the Ozark Mountains. Stanley's grandfather was a zealous pastor who reviled his son and took it out on Stanley. After Stanley's grandfather died due to a rattler bite, his congregation held a for him, and young Stanley presumably saw a sin-eater, a masked hermit who would eat fruit placed in a corpse's body to take the dead's sins for himself. Stanley felt a kinship with the sin-eater, since he believed himself to carry the burden of his father's sins. When the sin-eater looked back at Stanley, the young boy felt like he had been marked. A few weeks later, Stanley's mother came and retrieved her son so that she could raise him in New York City. As an adult, Stanley became a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Stanley volunteered for an experimental drug, developed by S.H.I.E.L.D. R&D basing on and aimed to increase strength and stamina. The project was interrupted because it was considered too dangerous, and Carter, who considered this an affront and an abuse of authority, violently resigned. There were no traces of drugs in his system, being totally purified, but nevertheless the drugs had already driven him crazy. ===Becoming the Sin-Eater=== Carter then joined the NYPD and became a detective. When his partner dabbled in drug trafficking and Carter discovered this, Stan murdered him in cold blood. However, he repressed the episode, becoming convinced that his partner had instead died in a shoot-out. Stanley went on a crusade to find the drug pushers suspected for the murder and executed them. This unchained in Stanley an obsession to destroy people who abused their authority and thus "sinned." He decided to "absorb the sins of the world". He wanted to purge evildoers from a society where nobody else could punish them. He bought a shotgun and clothes to improvise a costume and became the Sin-Eater. left|thumb|As Sin-Eater The Sin-Eater's first victim was his own lover, police captain Jean DeWolff, whose death attracted attention throughout all New York City — including DeWolff's friend Spider-Man. The Sin-Eater had stolen DeWolff's purse, creating a precedent of taking one personal object from each of the victims. The object should be "associated" with the victim's sins. Ironically, Carter was assigned the task to find DeWolff's murderer and work with Spider-Man. The Sin-Eater then murdered Judge Horace Rosenthal, who was a friend of Matt Murdock, blind lawyer and secretly masked crimefighter Daredevil. While leaving the crime scene, the Sin-Eater met Spider-Man and shot him, accidentally killing an innocent bystander. Spider-Man found his own aunt May Parker in the alarmed crowd, so he had to stop and confirm she was all right. In the confusion, the Sin-Eater escaped. The Sin-Eater's third victim was Reverend Bernard Finn, an African-American priest. This led to a large public protest against the Sin-Eater. The Sin-Eater then entered the Daily Bugle looking for J. Jonah Jameson. Joe Robertson pretended to be Jameson, to attract the Sin-Eater's attention so he would free his hostage. The Sin-Eater aimed at Robertson but Peter Parker (who was really Spider-Man) knocked him out by surprise. The Sin-Eater was captured and then unmasked to reveal Emil Gregg, Carter's neighbor. An unbalanced person, Gregg had overheard Carter planning the murders from the thin walls, and he thought he was hearing "inner voices" ordering him to murder Jameson. Daredevil's improved senses discovered that Gregg was not the Sin-Eater and, by examining Gregg's house, Daredevil and Spider-Man discovered a door to Carter's, and the Sin-Eater's paraphernalia there. Daredevil and Spider-Man discovered that Jameson was the next on the list and went to rescue him. Daredevil and Spider-Man found the Sin-Eater in Jameson's home and stopped him in time to save Betty Brant-Leeds, Jameson's secretary who was there visiting Jameson's wife Marla (both Jameson and Betty's husband Ned were away on a business trip). Spider-Man felt that Carter had betrayed him personally and beat him, but Daredevil stopped him before he could kill Carter. Carter was sent to jail and judged, but he was found not guilty due to madness and sent to a mental hospital. However, a mob believed that the police had been working along with Carter, "one of their own", to protect him. The fact that Carter would not even go to jail was also an offense to them. stanley carter.bio: ===Early Life=== Stanley Carter's parents were drug addicts who became romantically involved with one another. Stanley's father later died, leaving Stanley's mother pregnant and alone. Stanley's mother was sent to a rehabilitation clinic and Stanley went to be raised by his grandparents in the Ozark Mountains. Stanley's grandfather was a zealous pastor who reviled his son and took it out on Stanley. After Stanley's grandfather died due to a rattler bite, his congregation held a for him, and young Stanley presumably saw a sin-eater, a masked hermit who would eat fruit placed in a corpse's body to take the dead's sins for himself. Stanley felt a kinship with the sin-eater, since he believed himself to carry the burden of his father's sins. When the sin-eater looked back at Stanley, the young boy felt like he had been marked. A few weeks later, Stanley's mother came and retrieved her son so that she could raise him in New York City. As an adult, Stanley became a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Stanley volunteered for an experimental drug, developed by S.H.I.E.L.D. R&D basing on and aimed to increase strength and stamina. The project was interrupted because it was considered too dangerous, and Carter, who considered this an affront and an abuse of authority, violently resigned. There were no traces of drugs in his system, being totally purified, but nevertheless the drugs had already driven him crazy. ===Becoming the Sin-Eater=== Carter then joined the NYPD and became a detective. When his partner dabbled in drug trafficking and Carter discovered this, Stan murdered him in cold blood. However, he repressed the episode, becoming convinced that his partner had instead died in a shoot-out. Stanley went on a crusade to find the drug pushers suspected for the murder and executed them. This unchained in Stanley an obsession to destroy people who abused their authority and thus "sinned." He decided to "absorb the sins of the world". He wanted to purge evildoers from a society where nobody else could punish them. He bought a shotgun and clothes to improvise a costume and became the Sin-Eater. left|thumb|As Sin-Eater The Sin-Eater's first victim was his own lover, police captain Jean DeWolff, whose death attracted attention throughout all New York City — including DeWolff's friend Spider-Man. Ironically, Carter was assigned the task to find DeWolff's murderer and work with Spider-Man. The Sin-Eater then murdered Judge Horace Rosenthal, who was a friend of Matt Murdock, blind lawyer and secretly masked crimefighter Daredevil. While leaving the crime scene, the Sin-Eater met Spider-Man and shot him, accidentally killing an innocent bystander. Spider-Man found his own aunt May Parker in the alarmed crowd, so he had to stop and confirm she was all right. In the confusion, the Sin-Eater escaped. The Sin-Eater's third victim was Reverend Bernard Finn, an African-American priest. This led to a large public protest against the Sin-Eater. The Sin-Eater then entered the Daily Bugle looking for J. Jonah Jameson. Joe Robertson pretended to be Jameson, to attract the Sin-Eater's attention so he would free his hostage. The Sin-Eater aimed at Robertson but Peter Parker (who was really Spider-Man) knocked him out by surprise. The Sin-Eater was captured and then unmasked to reveal Emil Gregg, Carter's neighbor. An unbalanced person, Gregg had overheard Carter planning the murders from the thin walls, and he thought he was hearing "inner voices" ordering him to murder Jameson. Daredevil's improved senses discovered that Gregg was not the Sin-Eater and, by examining Gregg's house, Daredevil and Spider-Man discovered a door to Carter's, and the Sin-Eater's paraphernalia there. stanley dee.name: Stanley Dee
stanley dee.origin: Stanley Dee was the editor at Crimely Comics during the 1940s. It was best known for its publication of comic books based on the adventures of Captain America. Dee always demanded the best stories out of his star writer, the clumsy Red Skeleton. In the summer of 1942 he had ordered Red to come up with a good plot for once. Later, when Red called in a story idea he had about the murder of a showgirl (based on a real life experience he had just lived), Dee rejected the idea because he did not think the story was believable.

stanley dreyfuss.name: Stanley Dreyfuss
stanley dreyfuss.origin: Stanley was created for Operation ninjagirl, a S.H.I.E.L.D op run by Nick Fury centering on Baghdad the capital of Iraq. Stanley recruited Elektra Natchios to infiltrate the operations of Saddam Abed Dasem who had gained power in Iraq and was working with Hydra. Elektra was tasked with killing Saddam and retrieving a box that contained the Zodiac Key. After attempting to recruit Elektra in Paris, where she used her ninja skills to vanish with the offered money, Stanley met her again in Baghdad where she killed Hydra agents who were aware of her before vanishing after using ninja mind tricks to mess with his mind. Elektra ultimately decided to take the job and went up against Hydra who hired Silver Samurai to kill her, while S.H.I.E.L.D was watching this fight as well as a televised debate where S.H.I.E.L.D were accused of spending four billion dollars producing Life Model Decoy's, a suspicious Stanley then searched his name and discovered that he himself was an L.M.D. Stanley confronted Nick Fury who confirmed it and told him that he was a L.M.D designed specially for the mission, hinting that he was made to resemble one of Elektra's past loves and that he was made too smart, smart enough to question who and what he is which Fury stated to be a mistake. Fury had the 'plug pulled' on Stanley which left him with only his internal battery supply to run on. Stanley ran and stole a vehicle as well as the Silver Samurai's helmet and picked up Elektra, driving her to the palace of Saddam Abed Dasem who had unleashed the power of the Zodiac Key. While helping to transport her Stanley admitted to thinking he might be in love with her and used his last words to wish they had been able to make out, before he battery ran out and he ceased to function

stanley george johnson.name: Stanley George Johnson
stanley george johnson.origin: One Wednesday night in New York City, Spider-Man was trying to help police officers prevent a robber from escaping. As Spider-Man was about to stop the disaster, Thunderclap intervened and told the webslinger he would take over now. He slammed his hands together, creating the sonic booms from his hands. The booms caused a lot of property damage, gave both Spider-Man and the police officers pain in their ears, but at least it took out the thugs. After getting a lecture from Spider-Man who later left the crime scene, Thunderclap apologized to the officers for the pain he caused. When a surprised press arrived and interviewed the new super-hero, Thunderclap introduced himself to the media and also blamed Spider-Man for the property damage. Due to this false statement, Thunderclap was promoted by the Daily Bugle as a true hero, because he apparently disliked Spider-Man as much as they did. A picture of Thunderclap was taken by Peter Parker, who is of course Spider-Man. The article of the paper was "A Real Hero: Thunderclap Halts Spider-Man Threat!" ===Civil War=== 300px|thumb|left|Thunderclap vs. Bantam When the Superhuman Registration Act was proposed, Thunderclap decided to take sides with Captain America against the proposal. However, during a battle against the superhuman known as Bantam, Thunderclap accidentally blasted his adversary against a nearby gas tank. The force of Bantam's crash caused the tank to explode, and Bantam was killed. Police officers and firemen managed to contain the disaster. Thunderclap tried to apologize, but feeling too ashamed for what he did, he disappeared into a nearby dark alley.

stanley klein.origin: Captain America and the Howling Commandos participated in the Battle of the Bulge. They fought off a squad of Nazis, rescuing the life of Private Stan Klein who was one of the sole survivors of his unit, and was holding off Nazi forces while keeping an injured soldier alive. Cap was able to return to Stan a picture of his girlfriend back home that was lost in the battle field. Captain America told Stan that his bravery was an inspiration.

stanley osborn.species: Human born to two Goblin Formula parents
stanley osborn.origin: Stanley Osborn is the first son born to Harry Osborn's clone, with his ex-fiancée, Lily Hollister. Due to the belief that he was Norman Osborn's, and that Stanley would inherit the altered genetics of two parents who had both taken the Goblin Formula in their lifetime, the young child's blood was highly valued by the criminal underworld. On the orders of Doctor Octopus, Stanley was nearly kidnapped. A DNA test by Spider-Man revealed that Norman was not the father of Stanley, since he lacked Norman's unique chemical imprint via the Goblin Serum. Spider-Man revealed Harry was the true father of Stanley, leading Harry to choose to raise him alone. After Harry's rekindled his relationship with his ex-wife, Stanley moved in with his father and half-brother. Following his father's death, Stanley was left under the care of Liz, referring her as his aunt and mother, and began attending the same school as his brother. As he was about to go to sleep, Stanley got a call on his mother's Stark brand cellphone from presumably Flash Thompson. Stanley answered it only to be met with Cletus Kasady. Cletus attempted to befriend Stanley before taking control of the little boy and forcing him to kill Liz while she was distracted. Stanley was about to attack Liz, but thankfully was prevented by his brother who was alarmed of Kasady's threat by his symbiote. Stanley was kidnapped by Squid Kid's Sinister Six during their assault on corporate greed.

fields.history: Stanley Osborn is the first son born to Harry Osborn's clone, with his ex-fiancée, Lily Hollister. Due to the belief that he was Norman Osborn's, and that Stanley would inherit the altered genetics of two parents who had both taken the Goblin Formula in their lifetime, the young child's blood was highly valued by the criminal underworld. On the orders of Doctor Octopus, Stanley was nearly kidnapped. A DNA test by Spider-Man revealed that Norman was not the father of Stanley, since he lacked Norman's unique chemical imprint via the Goblin Serum. Spider-Man revealed Harry was the true father of Stanley, leading Harry to choose to raise him alone. After Harry's rekindled his relationship with his ex-wife, Stanley moved in with his father and half-brother. Following his father's death, Stanley was left under the care of Liz, referring her as his aunt and mother, and began attending the same school as his brother. As he was about to go to sleep, Stanley got a call on his mother's Stark brand cellphone from presumably Flash Thompson. Stanley answered it only to be met with Cletus Kasady. Cletus attempted to befriend Stanley before taking control of the little boy and forcing him to kill Liz while she was distracted. Stanley was about to attack Liz, but thankfully was prevented by his brother who was alarmed of Kasady's threat by his symbiote. Stanley was kidnapped by Squid Kid's Sinister Six during their assault on corporate greed.

stansky.name: Stansky
stansky.origin: Stansky and Igor were sent by their superior to help the Black Widow use the Anti-Gravity Device against Tony Stark, Iron Man and Fort Knox. When they arrived to Black Widow's hideout, Stansky was eager to test the device, and used it without hesitation on a car in the street. The floating car caught Iron Man's attention while he was patrolling on the search for the Widow, and helped him find her hideout. Iron Man broke into the building and easily took care of Stansky and Igor, causing them to escape in fear. They reunited with the Black Widow in the street after she incapacitated Iron Man. They travelled to Fort Knox, where Black Widow used the Anti-Gravity Device to make an entire mountain levitate. Stansky and Igor where rescued by Iron Man from the mountain when it fell, and they were subsequently arrested.

star.name: Star
star.origin: When Mandarin sent a wave of Dreadnoughts to destroy the Three Gorges Dam in China, Iron Man went to help, and he found the help of The Dynasty, the new group of militarized Chinese superheroes. Among their ranks is Star, in a way similar to Captain America who has a star-spangled shield. The Chinese army decided to use jets to explode the Dam, so although they would lose it anyway, they could at least destroy the enemy. Then the Dynasty left the scene in a special aircraft. When Tony Stark was kidnapped by the Mandarin and forced to create new weapons for him, the Dynasty was contacted by Tony's friends Pepper Potts and Bethany Cabe of Resilient for help to rescue Tony. The cavalry arrived just in time when Iron Man was fighting Mandarin and his Titanomechs, which were destroyed by the efforts of the heroes. The Star died during Thanos' invasion.

star monster.name: Star-Monster
star monster.origin: The Star-Monster was a creature created by the Star-Gazer to aid his partner Dr. Gar in destroying the superhero the Blue Blaze. Using two devices, the Star-Gazer used one to create the Star-Monster and the other to power him by channeling the energies of a star. When the Star-Monster first fought the Blaze, he easily overpowered the hero, but he became inert at dawn when the Earth's rotation cut off the monster's access to its power source, allowing the Blaze to escape. The next time the Blaze fought the Star-Monster, he covered the creature in molten leader, robbing him of its energy and causing him to become inert. Later, the Blaze killed the Star-Gazer and Dr. Gar by turning a beam of energy against them with a mirror. What became of the Star-Monster afterward is unknown.

starbolt.name: Starbolt
starbolt.origin: Starbolt was a firmly dedicated member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard. The process which gave him flame powers altered his physiology to the point where a mate and children were impossible goals for him, leaving his duty to the guard as his sole drive in life. Starbolt first met the mutants of Earth when defending the M'kraan Crystal at the order of his emperor, D'ken. He was later part of the Imperial Guard unit engaged in ritual combat with the X-Men for the death of the Phoenix. When the X-Men were framed for imperial crimes, Nightcrawler and Shadowcat were held as captives by the Shi'ar. They tried to reason with Gladiator and Oracle. But Starbolt, for one, didn't trust the mutants' story. The issue became moot when Deathbird's Borderers tipped their hand and attacked Starbolt and the other Guardsmen. Nevertheless, Deathbird became the Majestrix of the Shi'ar after that. Starbolt served her and the Guard in the search for the Phalkon. He was later one of the numerous Imperial Guard casualties during their attack on the Cancerverse through the Fault and was killed by the Ex-Men in an ambush. They were all later destroyed by Gladiator.

starbolt ii.name: Starbolt II
starbolt ii.first_appearance: Realm of Kings: Imperial Guard Vol 1 5
starbolt ii.origin: One of the newest members of the Imperial Guard, he joined the team following their operation inside the Fault, where his predecessor was killed. When the focus of the decay of the universe was found to be the Earth, the Majestor addressed the Galactic Council, and decided that the Earth had to be destroyed to save the universe. Even though the Shi'ar planned a sneak attack on the Earth, the Guardians of the Galaxy managed to discover their plan and warned the Avengers. While approaching Earth, the Shi'ar alerted humanity that they had two hours left to live until Earth was destroyed by their fleet. Using a super weapon capable of channeling the Earth's power, Sunspot and A.I.M. retaliated against the Shi'ar in front, while S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Avengers used a Planetkiller seized from the Builders to attack from behind. However, A.I.M.'s weapon overheated and exploded, and the Planetkiller was destroyed by the Annihilation Wave. With no options left, the Avengers prepared to meet their end. However, the Illuminati used the controller disk of a rogue planet that shared the same space with Earth while phased while Iron Man flew to the Sol's Hammer and prepared to use it. Iron Man charged and fired Sol's Hammer, successfully destroying the Shi'ar fleet, including Starbolt. Once the universe was destroyed, it ultimately came back. The Shi'ar and the Imperial Guard were brought back as a byproduct of the universal renewal, with no memories of the universe's temporary demise, like the rest of the inhabitants of the universe.

starbrand dinosaur.name: Starbrand (Dinosaur)
starbrand dinosaur.species: Tyrannosaurus rex imbued with the power of the Starbrand
starbrand dinosaur.origin: thumb|left|The White Event Originally a normal Tyrannosaurus rex, this particular dinosaur was unlucky enough to be at the epicenter of the asteroid impact that caused the Cretaceous–Paleogene Extinction Event. The asteroid had been used to crack open the Superflow and the first White Event transformed the Tyrannosaurus into the first bearer of the Starbrand on Earth. For an unknown amount of time, the Tyrannosaurus defended Earth from threats such as the Kree Empire. At one point, he met the time-traveling Brandy Selby, a Starbrand from the modern era. Via an energy blast, he telepathically communicated with her, recounting his history, asking about her people, and questioning what his sacrifice would contribute to build, but Brandy, due to her really short lifespan, did not hold many answers, so she recalled to him all the meaningful interactions she had with her teammates before leaving to proceed with her mission. When he eventually perished, his body was buried and an oasis grew over his grave. The power of the Starbrand preserved his corpse, such that even 65 million years later it had not noticeably decayed. When the corpse was accidentally found by Vnn, the Starbrand transferred to him.

stare.name: Stare
stare.origin: Nothing is known about Stare, save that he was the leader of the Neo's Guardian Clan who retained his powers after the Decimation when many others did not. Hearing of the birth of the Messiah-child, Stare led the powered members of the Clan in an attack on the X-Men in hopes of receiving answers. Stare took Kavita Rao hostage, and demanded an explanation of the Decimation from Cyclops. However, an impatient Wolverine attacked him, and Stare gave the order for his clanmates to kill all the X-Men. Suddenly, the Evolutionaries arrived and declared the Neo a genetic dead end. An overconfident Stare attacked the lead Evolutionary, who tore his body apart from the inside out with a thought. The rest of the Guardian Clan, and then every last Neo on Earth, followed shortly thereafter.

Stare took Kavita Rao hostage, and demanded an explanation of the Decimation from Cyclops. However, an impatient Wolverine attacked him, and Stare gave the order for his clanmates to kill all the X-Men. Suddenly, the Evolutionaries arrived and declared the Neo a genetic dead end. An overconfident Stare attacked the lead Evolutionary, who tore his body apart from the inside out with a thought. The rest of the Guardian Clan, and then every last Neo on Earth, followed shortly thereafter.
powers: Stare was able to release explosive blasts from his eyes.

starktech 9.name: Starktech 9
starktech 9.origin: When Tony Stark was subverted by Ultron, Starktech 9 immediately went on-line and approached the current Avengers. It explained that in the event that Stark be terminated or rendered incapable, the Starktech 9 would go online to assist the Avengers or S.H.I.E.L.D. with the current crisis at hand. Ares distrusted the robot and sliced it in half. Only Henry Pym's word prevented him from fully trashing it. It further explained the danger of Ultron controlling a series of weather-manipulating satellites. They were able to repair the Starktech 9, and then set on a plan to defeat Ultron. Starktech 9 approached Ultron at point-blank range, among the crowd of overtaken Iron Man's armors and then secretly released Ares, who was shrunk down to ant size, determined to be the only Avenger Ultron had not encountered before. Ultron realized that Starktech 9 was immune to his control and destroyed it.

starr.name: Starr
starr.origin: Len Carson, a 20th century magazine writer, had incredibly vivid dreams which provided the basis for most of his work. Most of his dreams centered around the exploits of the barbarian born and king of Zardath known as Starr the Slayer and his battles with his arch nemesis Trull. However, these powerful dreams were putting a tremendous amount of strain on Carson's health and well-being and one night he decided that he would kill off Starr's character, hopefully ridding himself of his dreams in the process. As he was about to turn in a manuscript killing off the popular character, however, Carson was approached from the shadows by Starr himself. Starr accused Carson of being a murderer and assassin and killed him in order to preserve his own life. Upon killing Carson, Starr woke up in his native Zardath contemplating the strange and terrible dream he had of a powerful sorcerer who had brought him to a fantastic land of glass and light.

fields.notes: Starr served as a "warm-up" for the adaptation of Robert E. Howard's sword and sorcery character Conan by Roy Thomas and Barry Smith, the original creative team for . Starr was created before Marvel gained the rights to the Conan license. Its appearance was used in the early appearances of Conan, with the iconic horned helmet that would appear from to . Similarly, during the early days of the Conan comic-magazine , Barry Smith and Roy Thomas worked around creating a paperback comic-book dealing with the early years of Kull. Although the project was abandoned for various reasons, Smith produced a number of finished drawings, some of which were eventually published in as "Kull of Atlantis", featuring Kull as really similar to Conan's early appearance, with the horned helmet as well.* It is not made clear whether Starr was meant to be a part of the Marvel Universe or not. In 2007, writer Warren Ellis introduced a new version of Starr in the series Newuniversal. Another new version of the character appeared in writer Daniel Way and artist Richard Corben's 2009 MAX Comics series Starr the Slayer.

static neo.name: Static (Neo)
static neo.origin: Static was a member of the Warclan, one of the different communities of the Neo, who comprised different clans of recluse mutants. The Neo suffered a major crisis after the High Evolutionary temporarily deactivated the mutant gene. As a result, they unleashed their rage upon Earth and, more specifically, the X-Men, a group of mutant activists who promoted racial integration. The Warclan brutally attacked the X-Men. Static was part of the squadron tasked with hunting Nightcrawler down. At some point, the surviving Neo were claimed to have been wiped out by Evolutionaries. Although their fate is uncertain, their survival seems unlikely.

static warpies.name: Static (Warpies)
static warpies.origin: thumb|left|100px The young child known as Static is a Warpie who was created as a side effect of the reality warp initiated by Mad Jim Jasper when he attempted to take over Great Britain. Later he was "rescued" by agents of the R.C.X. when he was very young and brought to their facility to raise. Whether or not he was in the group of Warpies that was taken to Braddock Manor or the other one that was sent to Muir Island or a different one altogether is unknown. Months later when the super-hero team Excalibur was abducted by the R.C.X. on the orders of Agent Peter, Static was assigned to be the escort for Shadowcat while she was being held at Cloud Nine. It is also unknown if Static lost his powers at the same time the other Warpies lost theirs on Otherworld.

status quo.name: Status Quo
status quo.origin: Howard the Duck, now working as a taxicab driver, has driven a customer to New York all the way from Cleveland. This man, calling himself "Status Quo" was a mild mannered librarian when the constant advent of new fads drove him into a madness. Wanting to destroy all fads, Status Quo began studying how the media and advertisers help encourage fads, and now has come to New York in order to speak to people and convert them to his anti-fad group. This eventually leads to a giant demonstration in Central Park where surprisingly, Status Quo manages to gather a large crowd and earn himself a legion of followers. These followers are armed with gimmick fads (rocket powered skateboards, exploding frisbees etc.) and sent out to attack anyone who supports any kind of fad. The chaos brings the attention of Spider-Man who tries to quell the mob, and prevents them from spreading beyond Central Park, while Howard is chased after by some anti-fad goons who think he's trying to perpetuate a fad himself. Spider-Man eventually teams up with Howard and the two manage to expose Status Quo a hypocritical terrorist in front of live news cameras, discrediting him and causing his followers to break up. Afterwards Howard and Spidey split up, and Howard returns to his cab where he finds a police officer waiting for him to write him up on a number of traffic violations.

steadman sternberger.name: Steadman Sternberger
steadman sternberger.origin: Steadman Sternberger was a student that was often bullied so much that he dreaded going to school. One day, he was saved by fellow student Frank Castle who protected him from a group of bullies. Frank and Steadman became friends after that, and Frank defended Steadman from bullying to the point where people were afraid of going near Steadman. Steadman became worried about Frank's anti-social behavior and convinced him to join a peewee hockey team to direct his aggression. During a hockey game, Frank became attracted to Maria Falconio. Frank was too afraid to talk to her. So, Steadman wrote poetry for Maria and lied that Frank was the one who wrote it. Maria fell for Frank, and the two began dating, but this also meant Frank didn't protect Steadman as much. One night, Steadman and a group of young people went for a joyride in a stolen car. The driver was drunk and ended up crashing the car in New Jersey. The driver and passengers fled, leaving Steadman behind to slowly bleed to death. Frank later avenged Steadman's death by secretly killing those involved in the crash.

steed.name: Steed
steed.origin: Steed was an artificially evolved horse created by the High Evolutionary, as one of the third generation of the New Men. Since he had not yet completed his knightly training, he was not seen as a full member of the Knight of Wundagore and thus had no formal title such as "Sir" or "Lord". Steed was among the Knights present when the Acolytes attacked the High Evolutionary's citadel on Wundagore Mountain. Jumping in front of a blast fired by Fabian Cortez meant for Quicksilver's daughter Luna, Steed was able to allow her to escape, but later died from his injuries.

steel serpent death touch.name: Steel Serpent (Death Touch)
steel serpent death touch.first_appearance: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu Vol 1 10
steel serpent death touch.origin: The Steel Serpent was a martial arts instructor who was famous for his "Delayed Death Blow" technique. After he won top honors at a martial arts tournament at 19, he became obsessed with conquering K'un-Lun. He went to the mystical city twice to challenge Yu-Ti to a duel twice and lost both times. He travelled to the US to challenge Iron Fist to prepare for a third duel. Upon his arrival to the US, he killed the photographer Leslie Walker for taking a picture of him. Walker's friend, Tim Donahue, sought the help of Professor Wing and Iron Fist. During their duel, Steel Serpent's students poisoned Iron Fist with poisoned weapons and he was taken prisoner. Iron Fist managed to break out, and during their ensuing second duel, Iron Fist blocked Steel Serpent's Death Blow, resulting in a backfire that killed him .

After he won top honors at a martial arts tournament at 19, he became obsessed with conquering K'un-Lun. He went to the mystical city twice to challenge Yu-Ti to a duel twice and lost both times. He travelled to the US to challenge Iron Fist to prepare for a third duel. Upon his arrival to the US, he killed the photographer Leslie Walker for taking a picture of him. Walker's friend, Tim Donahue, sought the help of Professor Wing and Iron Fist. During their duel, Steel Serpent's students poisoned Iron Fist with poisoned weapons and he was taken prisoner. Iron Fist managed to break out, and during their ensuing second duel, Iron Fist blocked Steel Serpent's Death Blow, resulting in a backfire that killed him .
fields.notes: There is no known connection to Steel Serpent (Davos), also an Iron Fist enemy.

steel slammer.name: Steel Slammer
steel slammer.origin: Steel Slammer was a highly trained industrial spy that donned a mechanical suit to work. He had a profound rivalry with a fellow enterpreneur and art collector Stewart Ronalds, to the point of using his suit to rob him of precious art sculptures that Ronalds loaned to different art museums. He was intercepted, stopped and handed to the police by the Green Goblin.

steel fist.name: Steel-Fist
steel fist.origin: The man who became Steel-Fist and his two partners worked at Stane International at the time when Obadiah Stane acquired Stark International. As engineers, they had the opportunity to study and reverse-engineer some of the tech from the Iron Man Armor, and worked even more freely after Stane's death. Creating their own armor, the trio went independent as the Iron Trinity. While trying to steal a sonic bomb from Stane Int'l, Killdozer, Heavy Metal Jacket and Steel-Fist were confronted by the Falcon. During the fight, the bomb went off and damaged their armor, forcing the Trinity to flee.

steelbow.name: Steelbow
steelbow.origin: After the Avengers were killed by the Absorbing Man in Washington, D.C., Tony Stark created the Iron Avengers, robots based on the deceased Avengers, on the behalf of President Norman Osborn. Steelbow was based on Clint Barton, aka Hawkeye. It was a robot armed with Iron Man technology that mimicked Hawkeye's marksmanship, as well as being programmed with the original's personality. The Iron Avengers operated under the leadership of the Vision, the sole survivor of the Avengers massacre. They would serve as the first line of defense for President Osborn and New York City. Their primary task was to purge the Hydra parasites that infested the streets, and would aid Thor in fighting off Frost Giants brought to Earth by Loki. When the Skull invaded New York, the Iron Avengers were dispatched to try and stop his invasion. However, they were easily destroyed. Following the defeat of the Skull, King Britain ordered an army of Iron Avengers be made to protect the world following a number of global crises. Among the army of Iron Men created were a number based on Steelbow. They would be led by the Black Knight and aid in his attempt to liberate Magneto who was enslaved by the Toad when the two briefly swapped powers. Later, a number of the Steelbow models would defend New York from the resurrected Absorbing Man, and later would attend the wedding of King Britain and Medusa. The Steelbow model robots were last seen accompanying Iron Maiden into space to free the Eternals. A Steelbow robot also was present during the wedding of King Britain and Medusa.

steele fitzpatrick.name: Steele Fitzpatrick
steele fitzpatrick.origin: C.F. was a mercenary who operated out of Hellhouse receiving orders from Patch. He was dim witted and was friends with Fenway. C.F. is extremely fat and his body is malleable and resistant to most injuries. C.F. seemed to care for Deadpool and look up to him. When Deadpool left Hellhouse after his battle with T-Ray C.F. was distraught that he might never see Deadpool again.

steeljacket.name: Steeljacket
steeljacket.origin: Steeljacket was a post-apocalyptic zealot handpicked by Ammo to join his Munition Militia. When they prepared to attack the city as part of a plan to kickstart the collapse of society, Steeljacket and the rest of the Munition Militia were taken down by Daredevil, Luke Cage and Echo. When the heroes turned their attention to an explosive charge Ammo planned to have explode in another part of the city, the Munition Militia slipped away before the police could bring them in. Following the arrest of Slug, the Munition Militia broke into the New York State Supreme Court while he was in trial an attempt to break him free. They were stopped by Daredevil, who had attended the trial as a witness.

stefan halpern.name: Stefan Halpern
stefan halpern.origin: The man known only as "Pinhead" was a member of the Nazis during World War II. In 1944, he and his minions captured an elderly scientist to obtain a secret defense model. When he refused to talk, they kidnapped his granddaughter and threatened to torture her. However, their mistake was attempting to kidnap the girl while Miss America was out walking in the rain in her civilian guise of Madeline Joyce. This led to Miss America following the agent's minions to their hideout and freeing the captive family members. "Pinhead" was easily defeated and turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

stefan i.name: Stefan I
stefan i.origin: During the 16th century, King Stefan I ruled Latveria. In 1588, Count Sabbat helped King Stefan I finance the construction of a 110-room castle, overlooking the city of Haasenstadt, which by then had become the capital of Latveria; Until then and since the founding of the country, the King and his family, the Haasen dynasty had lived in a large manor house in the hills west of Haasenstadt. The Haasens entered the castle, by then completed, in 1590. In recent times, that castle was renamed Castle Doom. King Stefan then ordered a second castle to be built in the Bolgorad region, which was started and completed in 1593, and given to the King's cousins, the House of Draasen, in recognition of the family's devotion to the throne. In recent times, that castle was renamed the Citadel of Doom.

stefan klossner.name: Stefan Klossner
stefan klossner.origin: Stefan Klossner was a member of a group of Latverian college students that won a programming puzzle contest with the final prize being a trip to the Savage Land. In reality, the alien device that powered the artificial climate of this location was malfunctioning, so its administrators had set up the contest hoping to find the very best programmers from around the world to help them solve this predicament. Two fellow winners of the contest, American students Doreen Green and Nancy Whitehead encountered Stefan and his group while fetching their luggage. Stefan and Nancy immediately fell in love at first sight. They formally introduced to each other after Doreen tricked Stefan into mingling with Nancy while on a dinosaur safari. When the winners of the contest were presented with the predicament of the Savage Land, Stefan and his Latverian peers began to build a Doombot, as it was a standard problem-solving technique in their country. Doreen took another chance at setting Stefan up with Nancy by inviting him to join them for dinner and then leaving to the bathroom. Even though Stefan and Nancy were notably interested in each other, their clash of cultures, namely Stefan's obsession with Doctor Doom, got in the way. They eventually managed to settle their political differences and enjoy the company of the other. After returning to the lab from dinner, Stefan, Doreen and Nancy discovered an Ultron T-rex, which was behind the disappearance of components from the Savage Land's core. As Doreen changed into her secret alter-ego of Squirrel Girl, Stefan had his team's Doombot, nicknamed Antonio by Nancy, confront Ultron. Unfortunately, Antonio was destroyed and its technology was assimilated by the evil A.I. When Ultron held the remaining humans captive so they could program him upgrades, Squirrel Girl confronted the robot to distract him from Stefan and Nancy, who proceeded to rally their peers to rebel against Ultron and find a way to shut him down. The plan was eventually successful, and Ultron was stopped, with the damage in the Savage Land's ecosystem being subsequently repaired. As the students departed the Savage Land, Stefan and Nancy decided to remain in contact as friends. Despite the mutual liking, both agreed they weren't ready to date.

stefan krueger.name: Stefan Krueger
stefan krueger.origin: Krueger was the leader of a band of mutants known as the Freaks. He purchased the X-Man Angel and the Nhu'Ghari Avia from sailors of a fishing ship when the two mutants were caught in their nets. He later captured Cyclops, Marvel Girl, and Angel's girlfriend Candy Southern when they came to rescue them, and was duped into selling them all to the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, whose member Mastermind paid him with illusionary money. Realizing he'd been had, Krueger and the Freaks returned to the Brotherhood to demand real payment, thus allowing the X-Men to capture him as well as the Evil Mutants and hand them over to the police. His current whereabouts and activities are unknown. The X-Men tried to convince the Freaks, who were actually just deformed humans, to find a real life beyond the criminal career Krueger had them on. However, many if not all of them seem to have later become the criminal minions of Pink Pearl in her takeover of Clementine D'Arbanville's circus, and wound up arrested thanks to Aurora and Northstar.

stefan orjanski.name: Stefan Orjanski
stefan orjanski.origin: In Hungary, Stefan Orjanski seeks to desert/avoid enlisting in the army, fearful of perishing in a battle he feels no investment in. A woman named Nadja brings him to a sorcerer who can help, but Stefan is instead made to experience a deserter's life helplessly as a passenger in the bodies of the four men who were also seeking the sorcerer's aid in deserting, from becoming a social pariah to being caught and executed. He changes his mind and returns to join the army, declaring that honor demands it. But the whole thing was an elaborate ploy by the sorcerer, his four sons (Stefan's "fellow deserters") and his daughter Nadja to catch young men and compel them to enlist in the army, with Nadja blithely noting that they have duped 20 men so far and wondering how many of them will survive.

stefanya melnikova.name: Stefanya Melnikova
stefanya melnikova.origin: Stefanya Melnikova was one of the twenty-seven female orphans trained in the Soviet Union to become the many Black Widows. Like the others, she received a variant of the Super-Soldier Serum, along with other mutagenic drugs. When the Berlin Wall fell, Melnikova was working undercover in the United States of America. She refused to go back to Moscow to be debriefed, instead remaining in the U.S. under the mock identity Stacy Matheson, an abortion activist. She was eventually murdered because of her connection with the Black Widow program, but another Black Widow, Natalia Romanova, tracked the killers by getting clues from Matheson's death.

stegor.name: Stegor
stegor.origin: Circa 6000 BC, about 12,000 years after the cataclysm, Stegor was the king of the nomadic tribe of Homo mermani barbarians who wandered and plundered the Eastern Sea, the eastern part of what is now the North Atlantic Ocean. His arch-foe was Tanas, king of the similarly-barbaric and nomadic Western Sea Tribe. Both tribes sought a homeland and desired to claim the sunken ruins of Atlantis and the long-forgotten treasures of the surface-men. Since neither were willing to let the other claim that prize, the two warring tribes were determined to fight to the death and came to the ruins to do so. Stegor was accompanied by both his brother, Orrek, and his son, Kamuu, who was still just a boy. As was customary, the two rulers engaged in single combat before any other fighting began. Riding on dolphins, Stegor and Tanas battled in a joust of kings and Stegor's lance pierced the heart of Tanas, killing the western king. In response, Queen Elanna, widow of Tanas, personally led the charge against Stegor's hordes and vowed that Stegor himself would perish by her hand. During the ensuing battle, Stegor threw a spear that killed Elanna's standard-bearer, prompting her to hurl herself at him and knock him off his mount. The two then fought with swords and Elanna quickly overcame Stegor, driving her sword sideways through his body. Then, as Stegor fell to the ocean floor, Elanna took her standard and drove its spear end through his lifeless heart and into the earth, declaring, "Elanna rules the seas!"

fields.notes: According to the Tales of Atlantis story in , the war between the two nomadic tribes took place in the sunken ruins of Atlantis which had been a city of ghosts on the ocean's floor for the 5,000 years that had passed since the Great Cataclysm. This would place the war and the founding of undersea Atlantis circa 13000 BC. However, other stories and various Official Handbook entries give different dates. During the Hyborian Age, the body of water to the west of the world-continent of Hyboria is called the Western Ocean, later known as the Atlantic Ocean. Stegor only controlled the easternmost portion of that ocean while Tanas' realm was the westernmost portion.
fields.trivia: While the image of the two kings jousting while riding dolphins was interesting, it would have been unworkable since dolphins, as air-breathing mammals, would only have been able to stay underwater for up to ten minutes at a time. Having to return to the surface to breathe so often would have seriously disrupted any attempt to use them as mounts, especially deep down near the ocean floor.

steinbeck.name: Steinbeck
steinbeck.origin: Prudence Leighton was part of a network of secret agents and spies gathered by Charles Xavier in order to perform missions deemed unfit for the X-Men due to their sensitive nature. Her last assignment involved the purchase of Soviet Union Sentinels by military commanders of Cuba. Steinbeck|200px|thumb|left Prudence was murdered by Steinbeck, a pyrokinetic mutant arms dealer, before the eyes of Shortpack, her handler, who secretly loved her. However she did not pass on completely and took over Steinbeck's body – she accessed his powers and resources and contacted her brother. Prudence was falling into mental decay because her power didn't really work on men and she and her brother Shepard set out to assassinate Charles Xavier with one of the greatest assassins on the planet, the newly blackmailed agent Mystique. Calling herself the Quiet Man, Prudence played the role of a mysterious benefactor who offered to remove Mystique's tracking implant in exchange for her services. Unfortunately their machinations came apart when Mystique double crossed them. Prudence removed the Quiet Man's cloak and revealed she was still wearing the outfit she'd been murdered in (for some odd reason) while in Steinbeck's body. She and Mystique fought but Mystique proved far more capable and dodged Steinbeck's breath and Prudence's punches to stab Quiet Man in the stomach. Prudence's and Steinbeck's minds apparently went into overdrive and their powers reached critical mass. They began to swell and exploded, throwing Shortpack and Mystique far from the site.

stella botts.name: Stella Botts
stella botts.origin: Stella Botts was the wife of Harry Botts, a man with a weak character and totally submissive to his wife. Harry fought his miserable life with the only passion he had: his hobby of building ships in bottles of which he was a true master. When Stella crossed the line one day, something in Harry broke and although it was unusual for him, he violently attacked her wife, strangling and killing her. Finally thanks to his technique of building ships in a bottle, he stuck his late wife's head in a bottle.

stella mcreedy.name: Stella McReedy
stella mcreedy.origin: Stella was the wife of the chemist Jasper McReedy. She was an overweight woman, and knowing that her husband was experimenting obsessively working in his laboratory in the basement of his house until late on a serum for weight control, she told him that he should not overdo it on such a commitment that in any case in nature there were people who were inclined to be a little plumper and those who were inclined to be thin, but this did not convince Jasper who was convinced that the new discoveries were moving humanity forward. One day, Stella called Jasper at work telling him that strange things were happening in the neighborhood regarding the change in weight of various people and that she too had lost a lot of weight. Jasper thought about what had happened, since that morning his neighbor Tom Logan had also had a similar situation after drinking his daughter Linda's lemonade, and remembering that a first batch of the serum he invented and kept in the fridge had disappeared, he guessed that Linda had used it in the lemonade convinced that they were vitamins. Jasper asked Stella to confirm if by chance she had also drunk the lemonade and she confirmed, thus having proof that his serum worked.

Stella then reformed the Guardians with new members, while Tyreeze went on to think bigger.

stella webb.origin: In the wake of Thanos' invasion, Dr. Webb appeared along with new incarnation of the Enclave looking for Inhuman coccoons which investigate. After being abducted by the Enclave's leader Ted Goodrich, Inhuman Randy Jessup was given a tour through the Beehive, who noticed the Enclave's power source was too unstable. When the Hulk arrived to rescue Randy, he used the distraction caused by the Hulk's havoc to attempt to defuse the Enclave's power. When Goodrich attempted to salvage the content of an Inhuman coccoon as his entire work had been destroyed, he and Dr. Webb were engulfed by the creature inside it.

stellarax.name: Stellarax
stellarax.origin: Stellarax was created by Titan computer I.S.A.A.C. to serve him, alongside Elysius, Lord Gaea, Dionyus and other artificial created Titans, after I.S.A.A.C. was corrupted by Thanos, who implemented a failsafe that would create new constructs to continue his plans to destroy all life in the universe. As a lieutenant of I.S.A.A.C., he and the Thanos-Thralls were sent to Earth, their primary objective was conquering the planet. However, he realized that he was his own complete being and refused to be I.S.A.A.C.'s lackey. He would first conquer Earth in his own name and then return to Titan, to defeat his former master. He and his army, landed in the backwoods of Kentucky. He ordered that local population spread the word of his upcoming conquest, they left seven minutes later, having just razed the local area. They travelled to Washington, D.C., in the capital, his forces captured Rick Jones and Gertie, who were taken prisoner and sent to his spaceship in stationary orbit. At the Washington Monument, deeming the locals powerless, he demanded the surrender of Earth and gave them 24 hours to do so, otherwise he would destroy the entire city using a death-ray. He was subsequently knocked out by Captain Marvel and Rick Jones changed the course of the death-ray, just enough to prevent serious destruction. Captain Marvel and the other heroes, brought the unconscious Titan with them to his home planet. Later, Stellarax was recreated along with the other lieutenants by a now mobile I.S.A.A.C-Prime. With their powers being significantly increased and sent against Captain Marvel, Drax, and the Titans. When Stellarax tried to kill Drax the Destroyer during the final battle, Captain Marvel threw himself in the line of the blast. An enraged Drax returned the favor by permanently killing Stellarax.

They travelled to Washington, D.C., in the capital, his forces captured Rick Jones and Gertie, who were taken prisoner and sent to his spaceship in stationary orbit. At the Washington Monument, deeming the locals powerless, he demanded the surrender of Earth and gave them 24 hours to do so, otherwise he would destroy the entire city using a death-ray. He was subsequently knocked out by Captain Marvel and Rick Jones changed the course of the death-ray, just enough to prevent serious destruction. Captain Marvel and the other heroes, brought the unconscious Titan with them to his home planet. Later, Stellarax was recreated along with the other lieutenants by a now mobile I.S.A.A.C-Prime. With their powers being significantly increased and sent against Captain Marvel, Drax, and the Titans. When Stellarax tried to kill Drax the Destroyer during the final battle, Captain Marvel threw himself in the line of the blast. An enraged Drax returned the favor by permanently killing Stellarax.
powers: He was capable of firing bursts of energy from his eye and hands and possessed a form of . Originally, he had to use a energy mace to utilize and control his powers. His power levels, were later increased ten-fold.
transportation: Owned a spaceship that was equipped with a death ray, able to level an entire city.

stellaris.name: Stellaris
stellaris.origin: Most of Stellaris's history is unknown or clouded by mystery. She claims that her race had been judged unfit by the enigmatic Celestials and had been destroyed by them. She never explained how she happened to survive, or where she got her suit of living armor, but she used this claim to justify her pursuit of the Celestials and her role as a Celestial-hunter. She also claimed to be amnesiac and remembering nothing to little of her early life. She first appeared on Earth, following a "Replicoid" sent there by the Celestials to deliver a message to Thor and his ally Hercules, whom the Celestials wanted to go to the Black Galaxy immediately. Stellaris attacked them both. During the battle, Thor's teammates, the Avengers, arrived to help Thor battle Stellaris, and the replicoid was mortally injured. The replicoid was able to deliver the message to Thor just before Stellaris destroyed it. Stellaris then attacked Hercules, somehow sensing his past connection with the Celestials. Thor was finally able to defeat Stellaris in single combat, and discovered that Stellaris was a woman. After threatening to self-destruct her living armor and destroy the Earth in the explosion, Thor reluctantly let her go. When Thor and Hercules left for the Black Galaxy, Stellaris was following close behind them. As they encountered a ship of the High Evolutionary, Stellaris entered unnoticed. Stellaris freed and befriended Nobilus, a mentally unstable New Immortal created from cell samples of Thor. While Nobilus held off the High Evolutionary's honor guard, the New Men, and Thor, she plundered the ship's computer system. In the computer system she found the location of a mysterious red Celestial within the Black Galaxy. Elated, she grabbed Nobilus and took off for the location of the Celestial, hoping to kill her first Celestial. The High Evolutionary, Hercules, Thor, and the High Evolutionary's New Immortals followed behind her. Everyone arrived in time to witness the beginning of the birth of a new Celestial. The organic Black Galaxy was apparently the matter from which the new Celestial was to be created from. The vengeful Stellaris powered up her suit to its maximum level and charged the forming Celestial. A huge explosion occurred and seemed to destroy the whole Black Galaxy. Thor and the other unharmed observers saw that the new Celestial had completely formed. The explosion caused by Stellaris seemed to have provided the final energy necessary for the new Celestial to be born. A robot analyzer made the final comment that Stellaris' living armor was exactly like the armor worn by all the Celestials, implying that perhaps Stellaris was connected to the Celestials more intimately than she may have led others to believe.

stenya ubacowits.name: Stenya Ubacowits
stenya ubacowits.first_appearance: Hunt for Wolverine: Mystery in Madripoor Vol 1 2
stenya ubacowits.origin: Stenya Ubacowits was a mathematician hired by Viper to plot the flight trajectories for a satellite. The day the satellite was going to launch, the launch was called off because of bad weather, so Ubacowits went to the casino Wheelers & Dealers. A group of X-Men investigating Viper visited the casino since members of her Femme Fatales had been sighted there over the past weeks. When they noticed Ubacowits was being guarded by Bloodlust, the decided to abduct him and interrogated him for his connection to Viper. He told them everything he knew, and agreed to show them where the launch pad was located. After taking the mutants to the facility of the launch pad, Stenya was killed by Bloodlust when she caught up with him and his kidnappers.

stepford cuckoos.name: Stepford Cuckoos
stepford cuckoos.origin: After the confrontation with Trevor Fitzroy, Emma Frost was plunged into a coma for a year. During her unconscious state, Dr. John Sublime harvested over 1000 eggs from her to begin experimentation. left|150px|thumb|Genetically engineered by Weapon Plus (Earth-616)|Weapon Plus The Weapon Plus program then used the eggs to create thousands of identical mutant girls in the hope of developing a powerful weapon capable of killing every mutant on Earth by combining their telepathic abilities. The project was designated Weapon XIV and the girls were incubated and artificially aged inside the subterranean level of The World. While most girls remained dormant, five were sent to infiltrate the Xavier Institute as student sisters to hone their talents for Sublime's purpose.

stephan szardos.name: Stephan Szardos
stephan szardos.origin: Stephan Szardos was the son of witch-queen Margali Szardos. He grew up alongside his sister Jimaine Szardos and adoptive brother Kurt, who would later join the X-Men as Nightcrawler. Stephan was the first person Kurt showed his teleporting powers to. After he did, Stephan admitted that his mother had magic powers, which he and his sister were likely to have as well. Stephan was worried that the magic that ran through his family could corrupt him and turn him evil, so he asked his brother to kill him, should he ever turn and take an innocent life, to which Kurt agreed. Over the years, Stephan grew jealous of the attention Kurt received in the circus, and began to take the lives of children who displayed mutant-powers themselves — although it later turned out he had been possessed by Hive at the time. Before he could hurt anyone else, Kurt fought his brother, and though he didn't mean to actually kill Stephan, he did so accidentally. When he was found next to the body of Stephan and several dead children, the nearby villagers assumed that he had killed all of them.

stephanie bradley.name: Stephanie Bradley
stephanie bradley.origin: After losing the secrets of the Super Soldier Serum when Dr. Erskine was assassinated, the United States Army still wanted to produce more Super Soldiers like Steve Rogers. To this end, Col. Walker Price and Dr. Wilfred Nagel took 300 African-American soldiers from Mississippi to experiment upon. Only a handful of men survived the gruesome process, and only one of them survived the covert missions and assignments: Isaiah Bradley. Before Isaiah entered the Army he fathered a daughter named Sarah Gail, after her grandmother. Sarah Gail mothered at least five children, including Eli Bradley. Sarah Gail was born before her father took the Super Soldier Serum, neither she nor her children (including Eli) were born with superhuman abilities. Recently, after Sarah Gail remarried, Stephanie moved with the rest of her family to Scottsdale, Arizona. However, Eli stayed in the Bronx, living with his grandparents to complete high school.

stephanie briggs.name: Stephanie Briggs
stephanie briggs.origin: Wade tipped Stephanie Briggs off to Lady Octopus' attack on the Central Park Zoo. She arrived on the scene with a phalanx of officers, just in time to arrest Override, Aura, and the Looter. Briggs encountered the Scarlet Spider on the roof of Dr. Octopus' Staten Island facility and tried to convince him to leave. He refused and saved her life when the top floor of the building exploded, freeing Ock's Scarlet Spider duplicate. The Spider followed his doppelganger to the city, leaving Briggs behind. Briggs led a team of agents to the ruins of Ock's base, where they uncovered the now nanite-infused form of Wade. Unrecognizable in his Scarlet Spider guise, Wade made a crack about Briggs' former weight problem and fled. Later, in Manhattan's FBI offices, Briggs was told by Stone to stay away from the Scarlet Spider investigation but was given lease to continue searching for Wade. Receiving a phone call from Wade, Briggs met him in Central Park, where he explained what happened to him and begged her to arrest him. Before she could respond, he transformed back into the Scarlet Spider and fled. Briggs was assigned to stalk out Wade's house and suspected that Stone's interest in Wade was based on his desire to study the nanotech embedded in his body. She was waiting for Wade when he returned from attacking the New Warriors and brought him inside when he passed out. In the morning, Wade transformed back into the Scarlet Spider and knocked Briggs unconscious before escaping. Recovering, Briggs sped to the TV studio where the Scarlet Spider held five hostages. She arrived just in time for the Spider to smash into her car. Staggering from the wreckage, the bloodied Briggs persuaded Wade to confront his pain and resist his programming - and promised to be there for him.

stephanie de la spiroza.name: Stephanie de la Spiroza
stephanie de la spiroza.origin: Countess Stephanie de la Spiroza is the widow of a wealthy European man, Michel Dufours. She inherited Dufours Precision Manufacturing from her husband after he was killed in an "accident" arranged by the Arms Merchant. Having had a fling with Tony Stark that ended in her being rejected, she hired the Mad Thinker to kidnap Tony Stark in order to expose Iron Man's true identity. Years later, she hired Stark Solutions to save her from a hostile takeover by the Arms Merchant. She and Tony Stark put the past behind them and parted on good terms.

stephanie donal.name: Stephanie Donal
stephanie donal.origin: Having similar brain patterns, Yandroth merged his mind with that of Stephanie Donal, a scientist resentful towards those who had not recognized her genius. After the merge, however, Stephanie took control and carried out Yandroth's attempt at revenge against the Defenders, but she did so mainly with the intention of world domination by using Yandroth's advanced scientific knowledge to control minds. After nearly succeeding in mind-controlling the Defenders, Doctor Strange subterfuge managed to defeat Stephanie leaving her catatonic.

stephanie gerard.name: Stephanie Gerard
stephanie gerard.origin: Tired of being beaten by heroes while working for A.I.M., Stephanie Gerard partnered with former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Christian Poulsen, forming the Exchange, an organization comprised of former members of various groups. One such member named Liam acted independently with a group of Exchange members and fought a gang war at a reception of the wedding of Marine Sergeant Rachel Cole to Daniel Alves, resulting in the death of almost 30 guests and Rachel's new husband. This action put the Exchange on The Punisher's radar, who followed Liam in hopes of finding his bosses. Hoping to stop him, Gerard and Poulsen hired the new Vulture to kill Frank Castle. Their plan failed, but the injuries he sustained kept him out of commission for months. In that space of time, Gerard ordered Poulsen to find a solution to their problem, knowing that his unrequited love for her would make it hard for him to say no. His plan failed as well now that Frank had partnered up with the vengeful Rachel Cole. As Frank and Rachel planned their next move, Gerard began to reciprocate Poulsen's feelings for her. Eventually, Frank and Rachel launched a surprise attack on the Exchange. In the chaos, Rachel choked Gerard to death with a garrote.

stephanie hunter.name: Stephanie Hunter
stephanie hunter.origin: Stevie Hunter was a ballet dancer until a broken leg that never healed correctly forced her to assume a teaching position. She was brought into the world of the X-Men when Professor X was looking for a dance instructor to teach Kitty Pryde. Storm immediately had problems with Stevie, seeing her as a threat to her special bond with Kitty. thumb|200px|left|"Stevie" meets Kitty When Kitty invited Stevie and Ororo to a Dazzler concert, an outburst by the Morlocks Caliban caused the X-Men to reveal their mutant powers to Stevie. With their secret out, Stevie became more engrossed in the mutant world and joined the Institute as dance teacher and physical therapist. After Mister Sinister's attack on the Mansion reduced it to rubble, Stevie returned to her private studio. When Shadow King began to possess various X-Allies, he took control of Colossus and forced him to attack her. The combined forces of X-Factor and X-Men freed all of Shadow King's captives, and Stevie returned to the Institute. When there was an assassination attempt on Xavier's life, Stevie nursed the wounded from the ensuing conflict. Currently, Stevie is back working at her dance studio. Years later, Stevie was elected to represent Connecticut's 3rd congressional district in the House of Representatives and invited X-Men leader and old friend, Kitty Pryde, to testify before Congress on the state of mutant affairs.

stephanie lindquist.name: Stephanie Lindquist
stephanie lindquist.origin: Stephanie Harrington, initially nicknamed Viva but later known as Glitter, was a housewife and mother of three who had the power to heal and energize others by physical contact. The use of this power was accompanied by the appearance of twinkling stars and when not used internalized itself to make Harrington superhumanly strong. Her husband, disgusted by her powers, had placed her in the Clinic for Paranormal Research, which led to her absconding, being on the run for several months alongside other members of her therapy group, and eventually spending several months more in a coma following her recapture by the clinic and a vicious attack by its head of security, Harlan Hackbarth. She was recruited into the CIA during The Draft. Her husband agreed to take her back, but only because he secretly wanted her to cure him of HIV. She eventually left the CIA and began a relationship with David Landers, whom she had met at the clinic and with whom she had traveled for a time alongside the D.P.7.

stephen barkhorn.name: Stephen Barkhorn
stephen barkhorn.origin: Field Marshal Barkhorn, the youngest German officer to achieve the title of Field Marshal, led his division in 1940 to advance to the English Channel, showcasing his strategic acumen. Later, he was in charge of a Panzer tank division in North Africa where he emerged as the victor in the Battle of Kasserine Pass and met the sole survivor, Sgt. Nick Fury. Barkhorn spared Fury and left him. Months later, after the victory in North Africa, Barkhorn fought in Sicily. After the collapse of Tunisia in 1943/1944, he spent considerable time extracting two Panzer armies from a tricky situation in the Caucasus. Subsequently, he was transferred to the Eastern Front to fight the Soviets. Barkhorn took part in the Battle of Kursk, where he was ultimately defeated. While discussing troop movements, Barkhorn and his colleague Hans Von Stehle were approached by an SS officer who took them to a village to witness SS troops executing Jews. Barkhorn, enraged by this, attempted to kill the officer, but Stehle stopped him. Barkhorn was approached by Stehle and two others with a plan to assassinate Hitler at a meeting with the high command to end the war with Germany left unharmed, and prevent it from being pillaged by the Soviets. Barkhorn turned them down and decided to continue fighting against the Soviets. When Stehle was captured, Barkhorn, along with a unit of Waffen SS, arrived and surrounded the compound where he was being held. There, he had a reunion with Sgt. Fury and told him of his true intentions. Barkhorn ordered his troops to attack, during which Stehle was killed, Fury was wounded, and the rest escaped. Later on Hitler found out about Stehle's plan and believed Barkhorn to be a conspirator. He gave Barkhorn the choice of suicide, threatening that his wife would stand trial.
